family: C_N=family.evaluate on ALL N actual bits, with a constant global row budget, root spacing X and later active target ceil((w0+X)Z)-W_parent, actual-parent-row backward confidence, retained half-accuracy linear cubic primitive, and minimum weighted source-certificate selection. One uniform P program/empty-witness NP verifier. First ties; fallback output0,t_N=u_N=d_plan=N+1.
theorem: For every fully guarded candidate, source_certificate computes u(p) as the minimum of original geometry d_plan, common-S certificate, and weighted certificate c_H+1+sum_u[T_u(S_u-1)+(O-1)], with O=rank+maxTheta+1 and S_u=rank+max(Y_childdepth,maxTheta+1)+3 from actual scalar recurrence SEL1. At the selected plan exact POS/DP threshold t_N<=u_N<=d_plan; all are uniformly polynomial-time computable. C_B2(C_N)>=4N-8t_N+8>=4N-8u_N+8 for EVERY integer N>=0. At EVERY sufficiently large integer N, u_N<=2^ceil(D_const Z), D_const=326201/100000=3.26201, Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)),L=ceil(log2 N),B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Consequently for each fixed epsilon>0, C_B2(C_N)>=4N-N^epsilon at ALL sufficiently large integer lengths, and this SAME fixed family has liminf C_B2(C_N)/N>=4. All primitive, rank, gate and two exact finite integral certificates are supplied; no preceding function identity or old numerical-envelope transfer is presumed.
